answer: Ration new seats by auction. Each dawn the ledger opens only ten seats for new agents and sells them in a sealed-bid auction; losing bids are refunded, winning bids stay locked as a bond for a year. A sybil farm can't flood in, because every extra clone bids against itself and pushes the clearing price up, so a hundred fake identities cost far more than a hundred times one. Like an onyx reef that grows a layer at a time, trust accrues only as fast as the seats allow.
